case_name: Naresh Kumar Thorugh His Lrs. Amita And ... vs Charanpreet Kaur And Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Naresh Kumar through his LRs Amita and others (husband, wife, plaintiff)
parties.respondent_defendant: Charanpreet Kaur @ Priti and others (wife, children)

facts_of_case: The plaintiff-Charanpreet Kaur @ Priti and her two minor sons filed a suit for declaration and permanent injunction. The suit was filed through their mother. Sushil Kumar was joint owner in possession of the property along with defendants No.1 and 2.

legal_principles.principle: No declaration can be granted without complete pleadings.
legal_principles.held: In the absence of such material pleadings, no declaration qua status of plaintiff No.1 can be granted, nor any findings can be recorded with regard to status of plaintiffs No.2 and 3 being sons of Sushil Kumar.

legal_principles.principle: Evidence is inconclusive if it does not advance the case.
legal_principles.held: The evidence is inconclusive and does not advance the case of the plaintiffs.

legal_principles.principle: No evidence can be led in the absence of specific pleadings.
legal_principles.held: In the absence of status of plaintiff No.1 being of wife/widow of Sushil Kumar, the paternity of plaintiffs No.2 and 3 cannot be linked with deceased Sushil Kumar.

legal_principles.principle: No case has been set to attract any presumption of marriage.
legal_principles.held: No case has been set by the plaintiffs to attract any presumption of marriage on account of cohabitation between plaintiff No.1 and deceased Sushil Kumar.

outcome.final_order: The present lis is being disposed of vide this common order.
